notes.title: Patch note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/6f939bcf19832ba2593b600f4e487ec8bb630f43.png[/img]

After the demo release, some bugs were noticed and fixed:
[list]
[*] Minor fix to the Dude's quest
[*] Some hitboxes have been adjusted
[*] Fixed some localization errors
[*] The button for the next dialogue line now always blinks
[*] Fixed the positioning of some interaction points
[/list]
Thank you for your reports about the bugs you've found! If you notice a bug, please send an email to: rohan.denkotea@gmail.com
